questions.prompt:
Your CSS has p { color: black; } and .price { color: green; }. What colour is

$7.90

?
questions.explanation: Specificity: a class selector outranks an element selector whatever the order.

options.label: Black, because p comes first in the file
Green, because a class beats an element
Black, because element rules always win

questions.prompt: A box has width: 300px, padding: 20px and border: 2px, with box-sizing: content-box. How wide is it on screen?
questions.explanation: 300 plus 20 on each side plus 2 on each side is 344. With border-box it would be 300.

questions.prompt: Your rule h1 { color: #B5541C; } in style.css is crossed out in DevTools by Bootstrap's h1 rule. The most likely cause:
questions.explanation: With equal specificity the later rule wins, so your file must come after Bootstrap.

options.label: style.css is linked before Bootstrap's CSS
Bootstrap does not allow h1 colours

questions.prompt: A page looks right when you narrow the desktop window but tiny and zoomed out on a real phone. What is missing?
questions.explanation: Without the viewport tag the phone renders a desktop width page and zooms out.

questions.prompt: Which script tag lets Bootstrap dropdowns and tooltips work with no other file?
questions.explanation: The bundle contains Popper. Bootstrap 5 needs no jQuery.

questions.prompt: When does the rule inside @media (min-width: 768px) apply?
questions.explanation: min-width means from this width up, which is the mobile first pattern Bootstrap uses.

questions.prompt: An AI answer contains <button data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#menu">. On a phone the menu never opens. Why?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 reads only data-bs-* attributes, so the old ones are silently ignored.

options.label: The id menu is too short
Those are Bootstrap 4 attributes; Bootstrap 5 needs data-bs-toggle and data-bs-target

questions.prompt: You inspect an element with class="text-bold" and the Styles pane shows no rule for text-bold. What does that tell you?
questions.explanation: A real Bootstrap class always shows its rule when you inspect the element.

options.label: The class does not exist in Bootstrap 5.3; the real class is fw-bold
Bold text needs a font file

questions.prompt: Which prompt is most likely to give usable code?
questions.explanation: Version, part, content, behaviour per size and output format leave nothing to guess.

options.label: Bootstrap 5.3 from the CDN, no jQuery: a footer with three columns (branches, contact, links), stacked on phones, three columns from md. Only the footer HTML.
Write the best footer you can

questions.prompt: Which of these is safe to paste into a public assistant?
questions.explanation: Only invented or public data goes into an assistant.

options.label: Your GitHub password to debug a login
A real shop's customer phone numbers
An API key from a paid service

questions.prompt: An AI section looks perfect at 1280 pixels. What must you still do before keeping it?
questions.explanation: The four checks exist because AI cannot see a phone.

options.label: Test at 360 and 768, check the Console and inspect unknown classes
Ask the AI whether it is correct
Publish it and wait for feedback

questions.prompt: Where do you tell Copilot Chat, once, that the project uses Bootstrap 5.3?
questions.explanation: Copilot Chat reads that file automatically with every question in the project.

options.label: In a comment at the top of every file
You cannot; you must repeat it every time

questions.prompt: A column has class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3". The screen is 800 pixels wide. How many such columns fit on one line?
questions.explanation: 800 is at least 768 (md) but less than 1200 (xl), so col-md-6 applies: two per line.

questions.prompt: A row contains a col-8 and a col-6. What happens?
questions.explanation: 8 plus 6 is more than 12, so the second column wraps.

options.label: Both shrink to fit on one line
The col-6 wraps onto a new line

questions.prompt: You want no space at all between the columns of a row in Bootstrap 5. Which class goes on the row?
questions.explanation: no-gutters was Bootstrap 4. In Bootstrap 5 the gutter classes are g-0 to g-5.

questions.prompt: An AI hero uses <div class="jumbotron"> and appears as plain text. Why?
questions.explanation: Rebuild it with utilities such as p-5 mb-4 bg-body-tertiary rounded-3.

options.label: The jumbotron component was removed in Bootstrap 5

questions.prompt: You want one card per line on phones and three per line from 768 pixels. The simplest row classes are:
questions.explanation: row-cols-1 for phones, row-cols-md-3 from md, and plain .col on each child.

questions.prompt: An AI answer uses ml-auto to push a column right and nothing moves. The fix:
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 uses start and end: ms and me replaced ml and mr.

questions.prompt: A sidebar title must be an h2 for the page structure but should look small. Which is right?
questions.explanation: Keep the meaning with h2 and borrow the look with the .h5 class.

questions.prompt: A yellow label with white text is hard to read. The best Bootstrap 5.3 fix:
questions.explanation: text-bg-* pairs the background with a text colour that has enough contrast.

questions.prompt: On a phone, the cart table makes the whole page scroll sideways. The fix:
questions.explanation: table-responsive lets the table scroll inside its own box.

options.label: Wrap the table in a div with class table-responsive

questions.prompt: Product photos of different shapes make the card row uneven. What keeps them all square without distortion?
questions.explanation: ratio sets the box shape and object-fit-cover crops the photo to fill it.

options.label: A div with ratio ratio-1x1 around the img, and object-fit-cover on the img

questions.prompt: Which Bootstrap 5.3 class replaces text-muted and adapts to dark mode?
questions.explanation: text-body-secondary is the 5.3 body colour for quieter text.

questions.prompt:
Rice$7.90
shows both items on the left. What is missing?
questions.explanation: justify-content only works on a flex container.

questions.prompt: A dismissible alert's close button does nothing. It has data-dismiss="alert". The fix:
questions.explanation: Bootstrap 5 only reads data-bs-* attributes.

options.label: Move the alert inside a container

questions.prompt: You need a full width Add to cart button on phones. btn-block does nothing. What does Bootstrap 5 use instead?
questions.explanation: btn-block was removed; d-grid or w-100 replace it.

options.label: A wrapper div with d-grid, or w-100 on the button

questions.prompt: Cards in a row have different heights. Which class on each card fixes it?
questions.explanation: Columns in a row already stretch; h-100 makes the card fill its column.

questions.prompt: A search button shows only a magnifying glass icon. What must you add for screen reader users?
questions.explanation: An icon only button needs a name, and the icon itself gets aria-hidden="true".

options.label: A title attribute on the icon
Visually hidden text such as Search, or aria-label on the button

questions.prompt: A progress bar is drawn at 40 percent but .progress has aria-valuenow="75". What is wrong?
questions.explanation: The visible value and the announced value must be the same number.

options.label: Nothing, the width is what matters
aria-valuenow must match the width, so a screen reader hears the right value
aria-valuenow must be on the body

questions.prompt: The navbar toggler has data-bs-target="#mainNav" and the collapse div has id="navbarNav". What happens on a phone?
questions.explanation: The target must point at an existing id. There is usually no error, just nothing.

options.label: The Console shows a syntax error

questions.prompt: You want the navbar links spread out from 768 pixels up and collapsed below. Which class?
questions.explanation: navbar-expand-md expands from the md breakpoint, 768.

questions.prompt: A dropdown does not open and the Console says dropdowns require Popper. The fix:
questions.explanation: The bundle includes Popper.

options.label: Move the dropdown into the navbar

questions.prompt: In the FAQ accordion, opening one question should close the others. What does each accordion-collapse need?
questions.explanation: data-bs-parent links each panel to the accordion so only one stays open.

questions.prompt: The carousel area is empty until you click Next. The likely cause:
questions.explanation: Exactly one carousel-item must start with active.

options.label: No carousel-item has the active class

questions.prompt: How do you make a dark navbar in Bootstrap 5.3?
questions.explanation: navbar-dark is deprecated in 5.3; colour modes use data-bs-theme.

options.label: bg-dark with data-bs-theme="dark" on the nav

questions.prompt: Tooltips do not appear and the Console says bootstrap is not defined. The most likely cause:
questions.explanation: The starter uses the bootstrap object, which exists only after the bundle has loaded.

options.label: The tooltip text is too long

questions.prompt: "Remove this item?" must be answered with a button; clicking outside or pressing Esc must not close it. What do you add to the modal?
questions.explanation: A static backdrop and disabled keyboard close force a choice.

questions.prompt: The category list should be a slide in panel on phones and a normal sidebar from 992 pixels. Which class?
questions.explanation: Responsive offcanvas classes switch behaviour at the breakpoint.

questions.prompt: An element must show only on screens 992 pixels and wider. Which classes?
questions.explanation: Hidden by default, displayed from lg up.

questions.prompt: admin/index.html links css/style.css and shows no custom styles. The fix:
questions.explanation: Relative paths start from the file's own folder; ../ goes up one level.

options.label: Copy style.css into the admin folder
Use an absolute path starting with C:

questions.prompt: An Added to cart toast should be announced without interrupting the screen reader. Which attributes?
questions.explanation: Polite status messages wait for the screen reader to finish.

questions.prompt: Clicking the label "Email" does not put the cursor in the field. The markup is <label for="email"> and <input id="contactEmail">. The fix:
questions.explanation: for must equal the input's id.

options.label: Make the for and the id the same
Put the label after the input

questions.prompt: An AI answer contains <div class="form-group"> and <select class="custom-select">. The Bootstrap 5.3 version is:
questions.explanation: form-group and custom-select were removed in Bootstrap 5.

questions.prompt: A floating label overlaps the text the user types. What is most likely wrong?
questions.explanation: Floating labels need the input first and a placeholder.

options.label: The input has no placeholder, or the label comes before the input

questions.prompt: A customer can select both Delivery and Click and collect. Why?
questions.explanation: Radios with the same name form one group where only one can be chosen.

options.label: The radios have different name values

questions.prompt: A form has novalidate and class needs-validation. On submit with empty required fields nothing turns red. What is missing?

options.label: The required attribute is not allowed with novalidate
The JavaScript that adds was-validated is not on the page
The button must be type button

questions.prompt: In dark mode your footer text turns light but its background stays light grey. Which class is the footer probably using?
questions.explanation: bg-light does not adapt to colour modes; bg-body-tertiary does.

questions.prompt: You set --bs-primary: #B5541C and --bs-primary-rgb. text-primary is now rust, but btn-primary buttons are still blue. Why?

questions.prompt: A designer wants the focus outline removed because it "looks ugly". What do you do?
questions.explanation: Keyboard users need to see where they are.

options.label: Keep a visible focus style, restyled in the brand colour
Remove it and add hover effects
